type: shared physical-resource confounding, observation intervention, and provenance-preserving adjudication
sharedBottleneck: A predictive signal, digital state, accelerated endpoint, or autonomous action is not identifiable when specimen lineage, physical-resource assignment, and the causal effect of observation are collapsed into one dataset.

variableMapping.resourceNuisance: manufacturing block, chamber, fixture group, channel, and start wave
variableMapping.observationAction: RPT cadence and optional pressure-controlled expansion
variableMapping.verdict: held-out ordinal concordance after intervention and metrology gates

variableMapping.resourceNuisance: sensor chain, calibration, fixture, firmware, and maintenance history
variableMapping.observationAction: diagnostic schedule entering the state transition
variableMapping.verdict: independent residual and forecast audit with intact entity-activity lineage

variableMapping.unit: life-test specimen under a registered stress history
variableMapping.resourceNuisance: stress chamber, channel, start time, and inspection burden

variableMapping.unit: experiment proposal and physical execution slot

conditionsForTransfer: Experimental units and physical resources have stable identifiers and one-to-one lineage.
Randomization is generated before outcomes and is independently reproducible.
The observation action is recorded as a treatment whenever it can change the target dynamics.
Fit-for-purpose margins are fixed externally and measurement uncertainty is smaller than the claimed contrast.
Development and final adjudication use disjoint data, fixtures, implementations, or reviewers.
breakConditions: An entire chamber, fixture family, manufacturing block, or time wave is perfectly aligned with one hypothesis arm.
A repository row is treated as a specimen without physical identity and protocol lineage.
A calibrated instrument is assumed fit for purpose without an uncertainty budget.
A null acute test is promoted to long-term equivalence.
The planner can read target outcomes while selecting or replacing experiments.
minimumValidation: Reproduce the 48-cell assignment hash in independent Python and Node implementations; verify exact balance and single-domain survivorship; then populate external margins and U95 values, execute the disjoint sentinel and gauge studies, and retain an untouched outcome-opening event.
surfaceSimilarityRisk: Blocking and provenance are generic words. The connection is substantive only when the same unit-resource-action-verdict graph and its failure domains can be written for each problem; it does not imply that one battery result solves all four problems.
validationStatus: The software allocation and containment arithmetic agree independently. No physical resource, intervention equivalence, expansion repeatability, or lifetime outcome has been tested.
